title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
summary: Internal daily calendar for the Valdena Gelato shop, one row per day, with a boolean is_open flag and a free-text event_name for local events. Owned by Store Operations, stewarded by Elena Russo, and stored at azure://valdena-gelato/store/calendar. Catalog states temporal coverage from 2022-01-01 with no end date, weekly refresh, and about 1,500 rows. No wiki page documents the table. Data was not sampled, so content and population of event_name are unverified.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Local event that day, if any

schema.notes: Column descriptions are one line each. No formats, units, event geography, or allowed values are documented.

spatial.notes: The shop is in northern Italy per the use-case spec. The table has no location or region column, so event geography is not stated.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.store.calendar: classification 'internal'; contains_pii false. No licence field in the catalog entry.

access.request_process: Open to analytics roles (catalog). Other access terms not stated.

documentation_excerpts: Opening days, closures and local events for the shop.
is_open: Whether the shop was open
event_name: Local event that day, if any
Till system replacement wiki (till_migration_2024): 'No sales were recorded in that period. Treat those days as missing, not as zero sales.' (period 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10)
quality_notes: Row count vs coverage conflict: catalog gives about 1,500 rows, but daily grain from 2022-01-01 to last refresh 2026-10-10 would be roughly 4,660 rows. Either the table has gaps or the row count is stale. Not resolved.

No wiki page links to this entry (catalog wiki_backlinks is empty). The only related wiki page found by search is till_migration_2024 (Retail Operations, last edited 2024-03-12). It covers sales, not the calendar, and does not say whether is_open was recorded for 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10.
is_open = false must not be read as zero demand. Closed days are a separate state from days with zero sales, and the calendar does not record why a shop closed.
event_name is free text with no stated publisher, date format, event geography, or population rate. The share of populated values is unknown.
Refresh: weekly per catalog, last_refreshed 2026-10-10 vs catalog export 2026-10-14. Whether the window 2025-06-01 to 2026-03-31 is complete is unverified.
Opening-hour changes and the history of closures are not documented.
